description: Conservation of BBS10 nucleotide-site positions across 18 full-length vertebrate orthologs vs background
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

seqs=json.load(open("bbs10/seqs.json")); HUM=seqs["BBS10_HUMAN"][2]; L=len(HUM)
AL=json.load(open("bbs10/ortholog_alignment.json"))
# full-length gene models only (>=90% of human length aligned); truncated models reported separately
full={k:v for k,v in AL.items() if v["cov"]>=0.85*L}
trunc={k:v for k,v in AL.items() if v["cov"]<0.85*L}
print("full-length models:",len(full)," truncated/flagged:",len(trunc))
print("flagged:",sorted(k.split("|")[0]+f"({v['cov']}aa aligned)" for k,v in trunc.items()))

def cons_vector(panel):
    out=np.full(L,np.nan); cov=np.zeros(L,int)
    for i in range(1,L+1):
        obs=[v["map"].get(str(i)) for v in panel.values()]
        obs=[o for o in obs if o]
        cov[i-1]=len(obs)
        if len(obs)>=max(5,0.6*len(panel)):
            out[i-1]=sum(1 for o in obs if o==HUM[i-1])/len(obs)
    return out,cov
cv,cov=cons_vector(full)

# nucleotide-site positions in human BBS10 numbering (from the 3RUW structural mapping)
CAT={81:'D(GDGTT Asp, retained)',83:'A(<-T93)',84:'K(<-T94)',181:'R(<-K161 cat Lys)',
     50:'N(<-D60 NDG Asp)',416:'G(<-D386 cat Asp)'}
ADE={30:'G',31:'P',82:'G',85:'T',177:'Y',412:'D',602:'G',603:'G',640:'I',644:'L',679:'E',684:'K'}
SITE=sorted(set(CAT)|set(ADE))
rows=[]
for p in SITE:
    rows.append(dict(pos=p, human=HUM[p-1], grp=('catalytic/Mg' if p in CAT else 'adenine/ribose'),
                     note=CAT.get(p,ADE.get(p,'')), n_cov=cov[p-1], cons=cv[p-1]))
site=pd.DataFrame(rows)
bg=cv[~np.isnan(cv)]
mask=np.zeros(L,bool); mask[[p-1 for p in SITE]]=True
bg_only=cv[(~np.isnan(cv))&(~mask)]
sv=site['cons'].dropna().values
U,p_mw=stats.mannwhitneyu(sv,bg_only,alternative='greater')
print(f"\nbackground conserved positions n={len(bg_only)} mean={bg_only.mean():.3f} median={np.median(bg_only):.3f}")
print(f"site positions n={len(sv)} mean={sv.mean():.3f} median={np.median(sv):.3f}")
print(f"Mann-Whitney U (site > background): U={U:.0f}, p={p_mw:.2e}, rank-biserial r={2*U/(len(sv)*len(bg_only))-1:.3f}")
for g in ['catalytic/Mg','adenine/ribose']:
    s=site.loc[site.grp==g,'cons'].dropna().values
    U2,p2=stats.mannwhitneyu(s,bg_only,alternative='greater')
    print(f"  {g:16s} n={len(s)} mean={s.mean():.3f} p={p2:.3g} rank-biserial r={2*U2/(len(s)*len(bg_only))-1:.3f}")
print()
print(site.to_string(index=False))
site.to_csv("bbs10/ortholog_site_conservation.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax[0].hist(bg_only,bins=np.linspace(0,1,21),color='0.75',label=f'all other positions (n={len(bg_only)})',density=True)
ax[0].axvline(np.median(bg_only),color='0.3',ls='--',lw=1.5,label=f'background median {np.median(bg_only):.2f}')
for g,c in [('catalytic/Mg','crimson'),('adenine/ribose','teal')]:
    s=site.loc[site.grp==g,'cons'].dropna().values
    ax[0].plot(s,np.full(len(s),0.3+0.6*(g=='adenine/ribose')),'o',color=c,ms=9,alpha=.8,label=f'{g} (n={len(s)})')
ax[0].set_xlabel('identity to human across 18 full-length BBS10 orthologs')
ax[0].set_ylabel('density'); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].set_title('Nucleotide-site positions are more conserved than background')
cols={'catalytic/Mg':'crimson','adenine/ribose':'teal'}
s2=site.dropna(subset=['cons']).sort_values('pos')
ax[1].bar(range(len(s2)),s2['cons'],color=[cols[g] for g in s2.grp])
ax[1].axhline(np.median(bg_only),color='0.3',ls='--',lw=1.5)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(s2))); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{r.human}{r.pos}" for r in s2.itertuples()],rotation=90,fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel('fraction identical'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,1.05)
ax[1].set_title('Per-position conservation, dashed line = background median')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
